timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1440–1446.7 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently STRONG (low KRW per USD), meaning dollars are cheaper to buy right now—but the news indicates the dollar is weakening further due to Fed rate holds and dovish sentiment, with forecasts suggesting rates could fall to 1430 KRW/USD or lower. This means your $2,000 monthly conversion will cost fewer won if you wait.

TIP: Consider delaying or splitting your conversion over the next few weeks, as the dollar weakness trend suggests more favorable rates may be coming soon for your fixed USD obligation.
